MultilineRawStringIndentation:GamesDatum.kt:""" The players stand in a circle. The first person turns to the next and says three things and the next person should say three things which match the category. Critically it should be:
  • As fast as possible (high energy). Avoid filler words like "erm" or "uh"
  • Answers don't need to be 'correct' or 'true' (they automatically are!)
  • Treated as if the questions and answers are the most important ever given.
Variations: 15 Things, Category Things (name the category), Word-At-A-Time things, """

MultilineRawStringIndentation:GamesDatum.kt:"""| |The audience is asked for a source of text. It may be a text message thread for example. |A normal scene ensues. |One actor must read ALL of their lines from the source of text. """

MultilineRawStringIndentation:GamesDatum.kt:"""| |The audience is asked for line suggestions. A normal scene ensues. |Each actor will occasionally read a line from the suggestions. |It should avoided to reference that this line is a quote (e.g., avoid "as my Mom used to say ...") """
